Every moment is a new beginning. 🤍

Introducing NEW Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum, the newest addition to our Fine Fragrance Collection, inspired by the moments that shape us and the possibility each new beginning brings.

A fruity floral scent wrapped in creamy sweetness, this eau de parfum opens with bright pear nectar, blossoms into lush gardenia and jasmine, and melts into warm vanilla bean that lingers on the skin.

Experience it August 7 exclusively @sephora or early on the Sephora mobile app August 6.
